verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's charts explicitly compute subscription metrics (implied MRR/churn/LTV via 'chart lifetime value') directly from purchase data stored in RevenueCat rather than a bolted-on BI export ('Charts are generated from purchase data saved in RevenueCat and work independently from any in-app usage'), and it supports filtering/segmentation and even natural-language MRR-drop analysis via Rico. However, explicit named metrics like 'cohort retention' and formal 'LTV' analytics are only loosely implied ('chart lifetime value') rather than documented as first-class cohort/retention reports, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of accuracy vs bolted-on exports. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cohort retention curves, a clear LTV calculation methodology, and independent verification that these numbers are trusted as source-of-truth by users.
